projects.title: EventHub
projects.summary: Full-stack event management and real-time ticketing platform supporting dynamic event creation, attendee registration, and role-based access.
projects.description: EventHub is a comprehensive full-stack event management platform designed for seamless event publishing, ticket booking, and real-time attendee tracking. Built with a responsive React frontend, robust Django REST backend, and secure JWT authentication.
features: Full-stack event management platform with real-time attendee tracking and dynamic ticket generation
Designed RESTful APIs for event scheduling, user registrations, and category filtering
Role-based access control for event organizers vs. attendees with secure JWT authentication
Responsive, high-performance UI built with React and Tailwind CSS

projects.title: StudyRoom
projects.summary: Real-time collaborative co-working platform with multi-user sessions, live chat, and synchronized timers.
projects.description: A full-stack real-time collaborative co-working platform enabling multi-user sessions, live chat, shared task checklists, and synchronized timers. Built with React and Django using WebSockets for real-time bidirectional communication.
features: Real-time collaborative co-working platform with multi-user sessions, live chat, shared task checklists, and synchronized timers
Designed RESTful APIs and WebSocket consumers for real-time React↔Django communication
Implemented JWT auth with custom Axios interceptors and silent token auto-refresh
Deployed on Render with a cloud-hosted PostgreSQL database

projects.title: AI Interview Simulator
projects.summary: Full-stack interview prep platform integrating Hugging Face APIs for automated question generation and evaluation.
projects.description: An AI-powered interview preparation platform that uses Hugging Face APIs for automated question generation and candidate evaluation. Features a dynamic Q&A flow engine with real-time interaction and performance tracking.
features: Full-stack interview prep platform integrating Hugging Face APIs for automated question generation and evaluation
Dynamic Q&A flow engine with real-time interaction (React frontend, Django REST backend)
Performance tracking module: session history logging, response scoring, personalized feedback
Streamlit dashboard for rapid prototyping and visualizing model evaluation metrics

projects.title: Digital Laundry Management System
projects.summary: Full-stack workflow automation for hostel laundry management with REST APIs for order tracking and user management.
projects.description: A comprehensive full-stack workflow automation system for hostel laundry management. Features role-based access control, real-time dashboards, and structured API-driven order tracking.
features: Full-stack workflow automation for hostel laundry management with REST APIs for order tracking and user management
Role-based access control (student vs. admin) with a real-time dashboard for active orders
Data consistency via validated API inputs and structured PostgreSQL schema design
